name: Hans-Peter Müller
bio:
Hans-Peter's journey into motorsport was somewhat accidental. After completing his degree in Human Resources, he took a temporary position at a small engineering firm that was subcontracted by a Formula 3 team. The fast-paced, high-stakes environment captivated him, and he quickly realized his skills could be invaluable in managing the human capital within the industry. He joined Tolman Motorsport five years ago, bringing a structured and supportive approach to HR.

At Tolman, Hans-Peter is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his unwavering commitment to employee well-being. He believes that a happy and well-supported team is a high-performing team. He's particularly adept at conflict resolution and fostering a positive work environment, qualities that have earned him the respect of his colleagues. His loyalty to Tolman is absolute; he sees the team's success as his own.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Hans-Peter is a man of average height with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small Swiss Army knife.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk.
Has a habit of humming classical music while working.
